title: MultiUuError::DecodeError wraps uuencoding::UuError directly in public surface
description: MultiUuError in uuencoding-multi/src/error.rs has a DecodeError(uuencoding::UuError) variant that wraps the dependency's error type directly. This means callers of uuencoding-multi who match on MultiUuError::DecodeError must also depend on uuencoding and know its UuError type. What goes wrong: if uuencoding ever changes UuError (adds variants, renames variants), uuencoding-multi callers break even if uuencoding-multi's own behavior hasn't changed. The fix is to map uuencoding::UuError to local variants in From<UuError> — e.g. MultiUuError::PartDecodeError { part: usize, detail: String } — and drop the raw wrapping variant. This gives uuencoding-multi freedom to change its dependency version independently. File: uuencoding-multi/src/error.rs.
close_reason: MultiUuError::DecodeError(UuError) wrapping is the standard Rust error composition pattern. UuError is a public type from a sibling workspace crate with the same owner — not a third-party dep. Callers can match on the inner error. Adding an indirection layer would lose information.
